scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build --prefix client && wrangler pages dev client/dist --d1=DB=local-dev-id
scripts.d1:local:init: wrangler d1 execute product-ltv-db --local --file=d1/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute product-ltv-db --local --file=d1/seed.sql
